description: Transport Data eXchange (TDX) is a data repository run by Ministry of Transportation and Communications, Taiwan. TDX is the national transport open-data platform with APIs for railway, metro, bus, bicycle sharing, highway, air and ship data, including static network and real-time feeds, with an application key. Coverage: Taiwan. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api, json; access is free of charge; an API key needs a free member account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("TDX") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support transport network and operations studies of Taiwan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
